Game Overview

TrollHead to Face is a platformer title where race against the clock in TrollHead to Face, navigating as a whimsical troll-faced stick character. Leap across sky-high platforms, collecting gold and mastering double jumps while dodging obstacles. This humorous, fast-paced parkour adventure tests your agility and strategy as you strive to reach the elusive black portal.
